definitions.explanation: The weight or force applied to a structure, machine, or surface. A technical term used in engineering, construction, and physics.

examples.japanese: {荷重|かじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧。
examples.english: A design that withstands the load.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{荷重|かじゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧500⟦キログラム→キログラム：02872_kiroguramu⟧だ。
examples.english: The maximum load capacity is 500 kilograms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧{荷重|かじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}して→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: We calculate the load on the bridge to verify its safety.

notes: Composed of {荷|か} (load, cargo) + {重|じゅう} (weight, heavy). A technical/engineering term referring to the force or weight applied to something, not the weight of the object itself. Common collocations: {荷重|かじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to apply a load), {荷重|かじゅう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (load limit), ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{荷重|かじゅう} (maximum load), {荷重|かじゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (load test). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧ (fruit juice). Types of {荷重|かじゅう}: {静荷重|せいかじゅう} (static load), {動荷重|どうかじゅう} (dynamic load), {風荷重|かぜかじゅう} (wind load), {雪荷重|ゆきかじゅう} (snow load).
